form.label: Web, Email & FTP
form.description: The scored apps being attacked or broken.

html.p: A jump in 500s means the scored page is probably broken.
Severity 5. The website returned 10+ server errors in 5 minutes. The scored page may be broken. Playbook steps (page 15)

search.query: `web_access` status>=500 | stats count as errors values(uri_path) as pages by host | where errors>=10

html.p: Severity 4. Requests that look like traversal, injection or a scanning tool. Playbook steps (page 16) · Run the scope search

search.query: `web_access` | regex _raw="(?i)(\.\./|%2e%2e|/etc/passwd|cmd=|exec=|union(\s|%20|\+)+select|<script|%3cscript|sqlmap|nikto|gobuster|wpscan|feroxbuster|ffuf|nuclei|dirbuster)" | stats count values(uri) as sample_requests values(status) as statuses latest(useragent) as useragent by host clientip | sort - count

panel.title: Possible web shells (POSTs to .php in upload-type folders)

search.query: `web_access` method=POST uri_path="*.php*" (uri_path="*upload*" OR uri_path="*images*" OR uri_path="*tmp*" OR uri_path="*cache*" OR uri_path="*files*" OR uri_path="*media*") | stats count latest(_time) as last by host clientip uri_path status | sort - last | convert ctime(last)
`web_access` | stats count dc(uri) as pages latest(useragent) as useragent by clientip | sort - count | head 20
`mail` "Login:" "user=<" | rex "user=<(?<user>[^>]*)>" | rex "rip=(?<src>[^,]+)" | stats count latest(_time) as last by host user src | sort - last | convert ctime(last)

html.p: Severity 3. One IP failed 10+ mail logins in 5 minutes. Playbook steps (page 16)

search.query: `mail` ("authentication failed" OR "auth failed" OR "Authentication failure" OR "password mismatch") | rex "rip=(?<rip>[0-9a-fA-F\.:]+)" | rex "\[(?<bracket_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\]" | eval src=coalesce(rip, bracket_ip) | stats count by host src | where count>=10 | sort - count
`mail` ("Relay access denied" OR "NOQUEUE: reject") | rex "from \S+\[(?<src>[^\]]+)\]" | stats count by host src | sort - count

html.p: One sender spiking means the server may be relaying spam.

search.query: `mail` "qmgr" "from=<" | rex "from=<(?<sender>[^>]*)>" | timechart span=10m count by sender limit=10

`ftp` ("OK LOGIN" OR "FAIL LOGIN" OR "OK UPLOAD" OR "OK DELETE" OR "OK MKDIR") | rex "\[(?<user>[^\]]+)\] (?<action>OK LOGIN|FAIL LOGIN|OK UPLOAD|OK DELETE|OK MKDIR)" | rex "Client \"(::ffff:)?(?<src>[^\"]+)\"" | table _time host user action src _raw

html.p: Severity 3. One IP failed 10+ FTP logins in 5 minutes. Playbook steps (page 17)

search.query: `ftp` "FAIL LOGIN" | rex "Client \"(::ffff:)?(?<src>[^\"]+)\"" | stats count by host src | where count>=10 | sort - count
